verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a documented ingestion protocol is indirect and dated. Community posts describe a first-party 'notifier API' GitHub README explaining how to post JSON error reports, which implies custom clients can send events without an official SDK, but one user also noted its 'Official notifiers' link was broken. The Data Access API and webhooks cover reading and forwarding data, not ingestion, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: current first-party notify/event-ingestion API reference (payload schema, endpoints, auth), evidence of third-party or compatible SDKs using it, hands-on confirmation.
